Name: WorkbenchAllChests
Author: ZengGod
Description:
[b][i][color=#ff0000][size=6]Module Introduction[/size][/color][/i][/b]
[b][size=5]The workbench directly reads all containers in the local area, eliminating the need to place containers around the workbench; it supports connected containers , containers near the backpack crafting tab, and range[/size][/b]




[b][i][color=#ff0000][size=6]模组介绍[/size][/color][/i][/b]
[b][size=5]工作台直接读取所在地区的所有箱子，不再需要把箱子围在工作台周围；支持连在一起箱子、背包打造页附近箱子与范围选择；单机下自动跳过正在被使用的箱子（均可配置开关）[/size][/b]



[b][i][color=#ff0000][size=6]1.0.1 Update[/size][/color][/i][/b]
[b][size=5]Android compatibility has been added, and the mod settings menu has been optimized. [/size][/b]
[b][size=5]To maintain balance, [/size][/b]
[b][size=5]“Backpack Crafting All Chests in Area” is set to off by default; [/size][/b]
[b][size=5]“Workbench All Chests in Area” is set to “Read connected chests” [/size][/b]
[b][size=5]by default, but players can switch and enable it themselves.[/size][/b]




[b][color=#ff0000][size=6][i]1.0.1更新[/i][/size][/color][/b]
[b][size=5]适配了安卓，优化了模组设置菜单页面[/size][/b]
[b][size=5]考虑到平衡性，背包打造页读取箱子默认为关闭状态；[/size][/b]
[b][size=5]工作台读取箱子默认为读取连在一起的箱子；[/size][/b]
[b][size=5]玩家可以自行切换与开启[/size][/b]

Manifest.Name: WorkbenchAllChests
Manifest.Description: 工作台直接读取所在地区的所有箱子，不再需要把箱子围在工作台周围；工作台读取模式（连在一起箱子/全部箱子）、背包打造页读取模式（玩家附近箱子/全部箱子）下拉单选互不冲突、可关闭，附近范围可调，默认 13×13；含梳妆台等储物家具；单机不再参与箱子加锁（直接打开合成页，避免箱子被误判占用导致配方灰显）；兼容不同游戏版本（均可配置开关）。|The workbench now reads every chest in the area, no more surrounding chests; workbench reading mode (connected/all) and backpack-crafting reading mode (nearby/all) are single-choice dropdowns that can't conflict and can be turned off; nearby range configurable, default 13x13; includes storage furniture like dressers; in single-player it bypasses chest locking entirely (opens the crafting page directly, so recipes never grey out from a chest being wrongly treated as in use); compatible with different game versions (all configurable).
Manifest.Author: ZengGod
